candidate_relations.label: Atopic Dermatitis, chronic
candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is a composite: 'very severe chronic atopic hand eczema' (hand-localized, severity-graded, HECSI 244/360) combined with 'moderate to severe atopic dermatitis' (systemic/body component). C001 names only chronic atopic dermatitis without specifying hand eczema as a distinct entity, without the severity grades for either component, and without the hand localization. It is a compatible parent category but is missing multiple required specificity components.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures the chronic atopic dermatitis component but omits the hand-specific localization, the 'very severe' severity qualifier for hand eczema, the explicit hand eczema diagnosis, and the moderate-to-severe severity qualifier for the atopic dermatitis body component

case_quality_flags: Multiple positive patch test allergens (nickel, cobalt, sesquiterpene lactone mix, colophonium, MCI/MI, MDBGN, parthenolide, oleamidopropyl dimethylamine) suggest a superimposed allergic contact component; reference diagnosis does not explicitly address this, which may represent an incomplete benchmark.
